# KINBO TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED

> Enterprise technology company building intelligent everyday applications.

## Company Overview

KINBO TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED is an enterprise technology company founded by Arjun Jayesh. The company specializes in building intelligent, practical applications that combine cutting-edge technology with user-focused design. Operating across India, China, and the GCC region, KINBO TECHNOLOGIES develops solutions spanning enterprise software, artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, and research infrastructure.

## Founder

**Arjun Jayesh** — Founder & Systems Architect
- Expertise: AI Engineering, Healthcare Technology, Computer Vision, RAG Systems, Clinical Workflow Optimization
- Role: Lead architect and technical visionary behind all KINBO TECHNOLOGIES products

## Products

### QueueZero (Q0)
Clinical infrastructure platform for healthcare facilities. Provides real-time patient queue management, clinical assessment tools, and workflow optimization for hospitals and clinics.

### Glowup
Consumer technology product focused on personal development and lifestyle optimization.

### Relic
Digital preservation and archival technology system.

## Services

### KINBO Hub
Full-stack product development and technology consulting services.

### KINBO Cares
Research mentorship, academic guidance, and educational technology programs.

### KINBO Expert
Technical consulting and engineering expertise for enterprise clients.

### KINBO Consultancy
Strategic technology advisory and startup infrastructure consulting.

## Technical Capabilities

- **AI & Machine Learning**: RAG systems, computer vision, NLP pipelines, biomechanics analysis
- **Healthcare Technology**: Clinical workflow systems, patient management, medical device integration
- **Enterprise Software**: Full-stack web applications, SSR platforms, real-time dashboards
- **Research Infrastructure**: Data pipelines, research methodology tools, publication systems
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Supabase, Cloudinary, Vercel, serverless architectures

## Technology Stack

- Astro SSR (Server-Side Rendering)
- Preact (Hydration Islands)
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Cloudinary CDN
- GSAP Animations
- Node.js
- TypeScript
